author: SickProdigy
description: Look up supported Rocket League Championship Series tournament information from start.gg.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: This cog uses the supported start.gg API for RLCS tournament information. As the bot owner, create a start.gg developer token and set it privately with `[p]set api startgg token,YOUR_TOKEN`. Then use `[p]rlcs upcoming` or `[p]rlcs event <start.gg URL or slug>`.
name: RocketLeague
